title: Make critical state persistence awaited
notes: Introduced QAController._set_state(new_state) ensuring that state machine transitions immediately await database persistence without fire-and-forget reliance.

Critical states (WAITING_FOR_CODEX, PAUSED, STOPPING, COMPLETED, FAILED, ANOMALY, RECHECKING, REPRODUCING, CONFIRMED_BUG, REPAIRING, VERIFYING, RESTARTING, LIVE_RECHECK) are persisted to controller.db immediately before any sleep, external wait, or shutdown occurs.
Unhandled fatal exceptions during initialization or run loop explicitly transition to and persist FAILED state before re-raising.
